recentItems.title: Seven countries gather in Turkiye to avert wider war
recentItems.description:
Foreign ministers from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Egypt and Turkiye, the R4, meet in Istanbul before being joined by the UK, France and Germany, the E3. Their first gathering in this format focuses on Iran and Yemen amid fears of fresh military escalation. Netanyahu campaigns on regime change in Tehran, while Trump signals possible new strikes and Tehran vows retaliation. 

Al Jazeera's Sinem Koseoglu reports.

recentItems.title: 'Ceasefire' in Gaza leaves 81 displaced and living in tents
recentItems.description:
A year after the ceasefire in Gaza, families like the Abu Ouns are still living in tents, struggling for water and food and fearing renewed Israeli attacks. More than 134,000 structures have been destroyed, and 81% of Gaza’s people remain displaced

Al Jazeera's Hani Mahmoud reports from Gaza.
